## 43f15cc63654

**Finding A2 — reproduced missing contract and validator/control drift.** Source SHA-256 `19449adbd63a3ccf2564e4bf4ef260760fe2ea3ac87ce775c9e8fb9f625aea84` has no `strict_canonical_like`, `SEMANTIC_WITNESSES`, or `lesson_identifiable`, so the strict audit semantic gate fails with “no semantic contract declared.” There are no selected task-local tests.

The focused source-bound probe reproduces deeper contract violations:

- `self_check` returns `[]` for an all-zero 8×8 grid despite the family requiring endpoint pairs.
- `self_check` also returns `[]` for one diagonal same-color pair even though the documented invariant requires every pair to be axis-aligned. Live canonical Racket execution leaves that pair unchanged, confirming it is a non-triggering impostor rather than a generated span lesson.
- `texture="warm"`, `palette_size=9`, and `n_distinct_colors=9` each produce a byte-identical grid to the un-overridden control at seed 721/sample 3/medium, so advertised controls are silently dead.

Evidence: `checks/audit/43f15cc63654-combined/checks/43f15cc63654_audit_semantic_gate.json`; `checks/audit/43f15cc63654-finding/probe-result.json`; and live Racket receipt `checks/audit/43f15cc63654-finding/racket-diagonal.json`. The separate defect-lint audit records one blocking texture-domain-overlap issue plus 139 warnings, including 132 strict-scalar cases, four dead helpful textures, a minimal all-background impostor, and lawful/degenerate classification drift: `checks/audit/43f15cc63654-defect-lint/checks/43f15cc63654_audit_defect_lint.log`.

No source was changed. A repair should first pin the rule, validate public call scalars and declared overrides strictly, remove or implement dead axes, make `self_check` enforce at least one axis-aligned pair and reject off-axis pairs, and add executable semantic witnesses/rivals plus portable task tests before training admission is reconsidered.
